description: This file defines the GuzzleHttp Middleware class, which provides static methods to create various middleware functions for handling HTTP requests and responses, such as cookies, error handling, request history, logging, redirects, retries, and request/response mapping.

classes.name: Middleware
classes.description: A final class providing static methods to generate middleware functions for handling HTTP requests and responses in GuzzleHttp.

methods.name: cookies
methods.description: Creates middleware that adds cookies to HTTP requests using a CookieJarInterface.

methods.name: httpErrors
methods.description: Creates middleware that throws exceptions for 4xx or 5xx responses when 'http_errors' option is true.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Creates middleware that records request and response data into a provided container.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Creates middleware that invokes callbacks before and after sending a request.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Creates middleware that handles HTTP redirects.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Creates middleware that retries requests based on a decider function.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Creates middleware that logs requests, responses, and errors.

methods.name: prepareBody
methods.description: Creates middleware that prepares request bodies with default headers.

methods.name: mapRequest
methods.description: Creates middleware that applies a transformation to requests before sending.

methods.name: mapResponse
methods.description: Creates middleware that applies a transformation to responses after receiving.
